jess_sales: hey team — ACME POC hitting a blocker on the embeddings/rerank flow. They call our rerank endpoint and get a 400: "dims mismatch (expected 1536 got 768)". They say they created their index with a local embedding (768).

sam_ml: can you paste the request body and the model name they're using for the query?

jess_sales: curl pasted below. model: "open-sim-1536" body: ```json
{
  "model": "open-sim-1536",
  "queries": ["how to reset my password"],
  "candidates": [ { "id": "idx_1", "embedding": <stored_vector> } ],
  "top_k": 5,
  "batch_size": 32
}
```
Server response snippet: ```json
{
  "error": "dims mismatch: query_dim=1536 candidate_dim=768"
}
```

maya_support: most likely the index vectors were generated with a 768-dim model (e.g., old-embed-ada). Rerank requires query and candidate dims to match. Two quick questions for ACME: (1) can they reindex with 1536-dim embeddings? (2) did they quantize/compress the vectors (PQ/int8)?

jess_sales: ACME says they used Faiss IVF+PQ and compressed to int8 for space. Reindexing would take ~2 days — too long for the week-long POC.

sam_ml: if the candidates are compressed to int8/PQ then dimensions still reflect base embedding size (768) — compression doesn't change dim count. We cannot semantically upsample 768->1536. Short-term POC workarounds: (A) run the query embeddings with a 768-dim model (so dims match) and call rerank; (B) perform ranking client-side: call our embeddings endpoint for query, fetch candidate vectors from their index, compute dot product locally; (C) reindex to 1536.

jess_sales: ACME asks if we can expose a 768 variant in hosted catalog they can call for query-only (they don't need us to change index).

tom_infra: we do have a similarity-768 variant in internal catalog, not public. I can spin up a lightweight instance and expose an alias for the POC on staging. Will need short-lived dedicated capacity if load > burst.

ops-bot: note: any dedicated spin-up requires approval for reserved capacity or a dev trial voucher.

maya_support: also check request batching — they set batch_size=32. Our rerank endpoint auto-batches queries; if they send many simultaneous calls with small batches, they might hit rate limits. Ask for observed QPS.

jess_sales: ACME reported ~80 qps during demo, then saw 429s ~120 qps. Logs show: ```text
2025-04-13T15:02:11Z [rerank] 429 TooManyRequests qps=125 limit=120
```

sam_ml: that 429 is our soft per-project rate limit. For a POC burst we can request a temporary bump to 400 qps for 48h (ops approval). For production we recommend Dedicated capacity or adaptive routing.

jess_sales: pricing question from ACME: are trial Dedicated instances free? They want SLA for demo.

maya_support: we offer a 30-day trial voucher for Dedicated for qualified pilots — require simple contract and contact for legal/security checklist. I'll DM template.

jess_sales: tom — any ETA on the 768 alias? customer wants to test today.

tom_infra: spun up staging alias: "similarity-768-poc-acme" on region us-west-2. Endpoint: https://api.redwood/staging/embeddings/similarity-768-poc-acme. Please test with same candidate vectors (no reindex). I also bumped temporary qps to 400 for this project id (48h).

jess_sales: testing now — switching model to similarity-768 in curl. Result: 200, rerank returns top_k results. :tada:

jess_sales: ACME confirm: rerank results look reasonable, demo succeeded. They noted latency a bit higher due to staging node.

maya_support: follow-ups: (1) confirm no security blockers — do they require KMS/HSM for candidate data? (2) send trial Dedicated voucher if they want smoother perf.

sam_ml: note for internal: log ticket to ensure we document cross-dim failure message and recommend reindex vs query-model fallback in docs. Also add note about compressed candidate types (PQ/int8) so support can triage faster.

tom_infra: logged INFRA-3241: add 768 variant to public catalog and autoscale rules for POC workloads.

jess_sales: ACME asked about a permanent solution: they prefer to keep faiss compressed index (768) and have our hosted query use 768 model. Will evaluate Dedicated if traffic increases. I'll share legal contact.

maya_support: I shared trial template and next steps in DM. Closing loop: customer demo success. If no objections I'll archive this thread. :thumbsup:

sam_ml: great. small note — we should add an explicit error message hint: "candidate_dim mismatch: check index model/alias or reindex". I'll follow up with docs PR.

jess_sales: thanks all, closing from ACME side. Will reopen if they hit perf/blockers.
